lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: PUT THAT DOWN JOY [beat] YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHAT KIND OF TROUBLE WE ARE IN IF HUDA CATCHES US HOLDING THESE!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: But Nix [beat] look at this photo of Kamal! There is a price tag written on the back of his head like he is some kind of product!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: It is not just him [beat] every single teacher who disagreed with the new budget has a red cross over their eyes in this file!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... [beat] I hear heels clicking in the hallway! Get under the desk and do not breathe until I say it is safe!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I do not care if they have families [beat] if they do not sign the loyalty pledge by midnight [beat] make sure their careers are over!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I can see her shoes through the gap [beat] she is holding a shredder and a thick stack of folders with our names on them!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Who left this cabinet unlocked? [beat] I know someone was snooping around in my private records and they are going to regret it!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: My phone is vibrating in my pocket [beat] it is my mom calling and I cannot reach the silence button without making a noise!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I hear a buzzing sound coming from under my own mahogany desk [beat] come out right now before I call the security team!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Stay back! [beat] We saw the files Huda! We know you are trying to sell the school land to a private developer!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You think you found a secret [beat] but you have no idea how deep this hole goes or who is actually funding my project!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait... [beat] why is my dad Rafiq walking into the office right now with a briefcase full of money and a smile?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The betrayal was coming from inside the house [beat] and Nix's world was about to crumble into a million pieces.
